cutoff_ladder.note: coarse stage supplies the start only; convergence, energy audit and certificate are at the full cutoff (history and work above are full-cutoff only; coarse_history holds the coarse maps, energies at the coarse cutoff). D1: coarse_fine_step_equivalents = coarse_h_full_grid_equivalents / (fine_h_vectors / fine_scf_steps) (recorded H per fine step, certificate excluded); coarse_wall_fine_step_equivalents = coarse_stage_s / ((timings.steps_s - timings.certificate.wall_s) / fine_scf_steps); total_step_equivalents = fine_scf_steps + coarse_fine_step_equivalents; total_h_full_grid_equivalents = coarse equivalents + fine recorded + fine certificate H; distances in the density-residual norm (Bohr^-3/2)

davidson_lean.note: process totals of the serial real Davidson (all solves, both paths; MPI distributed solver not counted)

davidson_stages.note: BAANDI_DAVIDSON_STAGES=on; serial real Davidson only; width 0 = returning iteration; h_apply includes certificate and restart applications
davidson_stages.work_timers_note: BAANDI_DAVIDSON_STAGES=on. fft and h_apply_parts: seconds summed over worker threads (thread-seconds; at T>1 compare with wall only after dividing by the busy threads), counts independent of the thread count. fft.pair_*: paired orbital transforms of the real Gamma h_apply (one inverse and one forward transform per pair, as QE's fftw count of wave transforms); pair_potential_s is the grid multiply between them, not FFT. fft.density_*: density transforms (one inverse each). fft.other_*: other wave transforms (complex-path local applies, folded odd tail), one inverse and one forward each. fft.kept_*: REUSE-PSI forward transforms of kept psi(r) times the potential change (one forward each, no inverse). h_apply_parts: real Gamma block applications (apply_s whole call, local_s wall of the local part on the calling thread including pack/unpack, nonlocal projection P^T X and back product); remainder_s = apply - local - nonlocal (kinetic, scans). by_run_stage splits every block by run stage (fine, ladder coarse, verification = certificate block); the pooled keys are the sums. MPI M2 path (distributed solver and operator): stage_s maps the distributed solver stages (reduced_gram -> reduced, reduced_eigen -> eigen, rotate, residual, orthonormalize, apply_total -> h_apply incl. the per-block finiteness scan outside it, precondition; sketch 0; iteration widths are not recorded); h_apply_parts: local_s = mirror exchange, pack, distributed pair FFTs with transposes and potential, mirror-h exchange, unpack and kinetic term; nonlocal_projection_s = local P^T X and its tree sum; nonlocal_back_s = coupling, P W and image update; fft.pair_unsplit_s = the distributed pair FFT call (transposes included), fft.density_* the band-density pair transforms (one inverse per pair), fft.kept_* the potential-change transforms (forward per pair; inverse of non-kept pairs inside the seconds); collectives.* = calls and seconds of every collective of the run stage (all) and of those inside H applications (in_h_apply). Seconds need BAANDI_STAGE_TIMERS=on (off: counts only). With two or more ranks every number is the MAXIMUM over ranks (critical path, entries derived per rank first), min_over_ranks the minimum (imbalance), never a sum; simulated ranks (threads of one process) share the process counters.

gemm_dispatch.note: process totals of the real GEMM wrappers (serial and MPI real paths); output m x n, reduction k, gflop = 2 m n k; route mkl_wide = dgemm only because of the wide entry; pure_output_bound / pure_panel_bound / pure_long / pure_short / pure_layout = fallback reason on an MKL build; pure_direct = direct pure-kernel entry; narrow = streaming kernels; rows_as_if_mkl (pure builds only) = the same calls under the route an MKL build with dgemm on would take (same rule and workspace); complex GEMMs (atomic start, k points) are not included

work.note: recorded = per-iteration solves in history; certificate = fixed-point certificate re-solves, reported only inside each history entry's fixed_point_certificate; total work is the sum

reuse_psi.note: armed = solves whose kept H X was brought to the new potential; kept_starts = armed starts the lean solver took (its initial equals the kept X), declined = armed but initial differed; kept_pairs: one forward transform of kept psi(r) (inverse saved), full_pairs: pair transformed both ways; nonlocal_columns_saved: columns whose P^T X, back product and kinetic pass were skipped (counted when armed); h_columns_not_applied: columns of the initial H application the solver skipped

scf_advance.note: maps_advanced = standard maps run as a bounded subspace update (Advance), maps_exact = eligible-path maps that ran the converging solve (first map, redo, candidates), declined = requests the solver could not honour; completions = advanced maps followed by the exact solve at the same density, by trigger; advance_h_columns / completion_h_columns = operator columns of the advance calls and of their completions (both inside h_vectors_recorded); ratio_* = advanced maps whose B / E was at or below / above the rule

execution.solver_note: lean applies to Ritz-value (standard-path) real-Gamma solves; residual-criterion solves (strict path, certificate) use the classic real Davidson; process totals including the cutoff-ladder coarse stage

memory_estimate.note: array payload estimates only; scratch, projectors, allocator overhead excluded; peak RSS unavailable in-process

closure.note: each rank's exclusive tree is closed on that rank (sum of its own bucket walls against its own external wall); max/min over ranks of the closed figures; the external wall stays the verdict

phase_profile.covered_wall_note: legacy: sum over buckets of the per-bucket maximum over ranks (maxima may belong to different ranks; not a closed tree, see closure)
phase_profile.note: top-level buckets are mutually exclusive (init, coarse, fine, fine_redo, verify_pass, verify_fail, materialize); wall = potential + solve + density + energy (+ mixing, atomic start, io); solve.* are exclusive stages inside solve (solve.other = the remainder); coll.* and m2.* are inside the stages, not exclusive; seconds = max over ranks (critical path) and min over ranks (imbalance), never summed over ranks; counts are per rank (max); with BAANDI_STAGE_TIMERS=off only the counts and the map phase clocks are filled

preflight.memory_note: orbital plus one real and one complex grid payload only; excludes scratch, projectors, allocator overhead; not peak RSS
preflight.summary: Valid: si8-gamma. Will compute spin-unpolarized lda-pz SCF for UPF composition Si:8 (labels Si:8; 8 atoms, 32 electrons), k mesh Gamma only (1 resolved points), cutoff 30 Ry, 20 bands, 1 threads.

scf.empty_threshold_rule: max(5 * occupied_threshold_ha, 5e-6 Ha); first empty required

BAANDI_APPLY_LEAN.meaning: lean real Gamma H apply (no redundant scans)

BAANDI_ATOMIC_REAL.meaning: atomic-start Ritz step through the real Gamma Hamiltonian

BAANDI_B1_MARGIN.meaning: B1 strict: a root whose sketch estimate is below margin x its threshold skips its explicit residual for one iteration

BAANDI_B1_NARROW.meaning: B1 narrow iteration whenever the explicit root set is smaller than the band count (off: fewer than half the bands)

BAANDI_B1_ROWS.meaning: B1 strict sketch rows (auto: ceil(32 / (1 - margin)^2), 128 at margin 0.5, same 8-sigma miss bound at any margin)

BAANDI_BUFFER_TOL.meaning: residual floor (Ha) of empty buffer bands above the tolerance floor

BAANDI_CUTOFF_LADDER.meaning: overrides scf.cutoff_ladder / fraction of the input file

BAANDI_CUTOFF_LADDER_STANDARD.meaning: cutoff ladder also for the standard profile (S1)

BAANDI_DAVIDSON.meaning: serial real Gamma Davidson of Ritz-value (standard) solves: classic (orthonormal basis, Ritz vectors of all bands in wide iterations) or lean (work order phase B: residuals of unconverged roots only, all-band Ritz vectors at return and contraction, unit-norm corrections without projection and a generalized reduced problem by Cholesky reduction; one orthonormalization when a pivot ratio of the basis overlap falls below eps/1e-12; rounding class)

BAANDI_DENSITY_PAIR.meaning: two bands per inverse transform in the density build

BAANDI_DENSITY_REDUCE.meaning: block-parallel band sum of the density, zero-occupation bands skipped

BAANDI_DGEMM_TIMERS.meaning: print per-site dgemm timers at exit (dgemm-timers builds)

BAANDI_EIGEN_FACTOR.meaning: eigen tolerance = factor x density residual

BAANDI_EMPTY_LOOSE.meaning: first empty band is a buffer band in steps above the tolerance floor

BAANDI_ENERGY_IDENTITY.meaning: nonlocal energy of SCF iterations from the band-sum identity

BAANDI_EWALD_CACHE.meaning: BREAKTHROUGH-4: problem construction reuses the Ewald energy of the previous construction on the same thread when the lattice, the ion charges and the fractional positions are bit-equal (the cutoff-ladder coarse problem after the full-cutoff one); bit-identical (the same pure function of the same inputs)

BAANDI_EWALD_FAST.meaning: INIT-EWALD-FAST: balanced Ewald scheme (dft-physics ewald::Scheme::Balanced): splitting parameter from the real/reciprocal cost balance for the cell volume and ion count, cutoffs from rigorous tail bounds (truncation <= min(tolerance (sum |Z|)^2 / Omega^(1/3), tolerance * N) Ha), ion pairs i <= j and the reciprocal half space with per-ion phase tables; energy, forces and stress share the parameters; rounding class (different truncation and summation, error vs a tight reference far below 1e-12 Ha/atom); off = reference scheme (eta sqrt(pi)/Omega^(1/3), bit-identical to the previous evaluator)

BAANDI_FFT_PROFILE.meaning: LANE-FFT Phase 0: detailed FFT stages and logical traffic under PHASE_PROFILE; clocks follow STAGE_TIMERS; no numerical change

BAANDI_FIRST_BLOCK.meaning: first-correction-block residual diagnostic (review E3): before every warm real Gamma solve a small Rayleigh-Ritz on the kept B vectors, the occupied residual block R_o = H X_o - X_o A_o, its singular values and effective ranks, and the unconverged-root counts of the Ritz-change rule against the true residual; read-only (the solve is unchanged; B extra H columns per solve when no kept H X exists)

BAANDI_HAPPLY_FOLD.meaning: fold the local potential into the pair FFT

BAANDI_HAPPLY_OVERLAP.meaning: overlap local and nonlocal parts of the H apply

BAANDI_IMPORT_CHECK.meaning: LADDER-IMPORT-SPLIT: orthonormality check of an imported warm orbital block (cutoff-ladder and direct-minimization hand-off, `initialize_electronic`): split computes the same per-entry overlaps (each the sequential row sum, bit-identical) eight columns in lockstep and, with a registered communicator, only for this rank's columns j (j mod P), with one 1-double tree sum of the failure flags; serial is the former replicated scalar loop on every rank; same verdict, results bit-identical

BAANDI_INIT_OWNED_STATES.meaning: owned Gamma projector rows and fixed-chunk atomic-start projections (rounding class)

BAANDI_IONIC_FAST.meaning: INIT-IONIC-FAST: the structure factor of the local ionic potential sum_I exp(-i G.tau_I) from per-ion, per-axis phase tables exp(-i m_k b_k.tau_I) (two complex products per ion and G) instead of one sin/cos pair per ion and G; falls back to the direct phase for any G whose Cartesian vector is not the Miller combination of the unit-Miller vectors; rounding class (phase rounding, about 1e-13 relative)

BAANDI_LADDER_BASIS_CHECK.meaning: plan-time coarse basis/band/subspace check: skip an incompatible cutoff ladder before constructing the coarse problem, preserving the ordinary full-cutoff result

BAANDI_LADDER_COARSE_RULE.meaning: cutoff ladder coarse stop level: fixed (LADDER_COARSE_STOP), or atomic (the larger of that level and the distance between the full-cutoff and prolonged coarse atomic start densities, same norm)

BAANDI_LADDER_COARSE_STOP.meaning: cutoff ladder: coarse stage stops when its density residual (Bohr^-3/2) is at or below this level

BAANDI_LADDER_FIRST_TOL.meaning: first fine eigen tolerance after the ladder hand-off: auto (standard per LADDER_STANDARD_SEED, strict cold 1e-2), cap (both cold), coarse (the last coarse step's requested tolerance), next (the coarse schedule's next tolerance: standard ratchet, strict factor x last coarse residual)

BAANDI_LADDER_FRACTION_RULE.meaning: experimental cutoff choice: fill the density FFT grid plateau of the requested fraction without increasing any grid dimension; no material constants

BAANDI_LADDER_SECANT.meaning: secant pairs carried across the ladder hand-off (S2)

BAANDI_LADDER_STANDARD_SEED.meaning: first fine eigen tolerance of the standard ladder: from the coarse ratchet or the cold-start cap

BAANDI_LADDER_STOP_RULE.meaning: experimental coarse residual stop: preserve the half-cutoff RMS budget per nonzero density Fourier mode (Parseval); never loosen the requested residual

BAANDI_LADDER_WATCH.meaning: diagnose early fine error above the contraction forecast from maps 1 and 2; record a path note after completion, never redo or discard work

BAANDI_LEAN_BORDER.meaning: PERCORE-KERNELS: borders of the lean real Gamma Davidson: separate (overlap border V^T E before the H apply, reduced border V^T (H E) in the next iteration, two transposed products) or fused (H applied to the unit corrections first, then one transposed product V^T [E | H E] of twice the width forms both borders, so the basis is streamed once; the pivot test follows it and a failing append discards the images, takes the separate fallback and ends fusing for the rest of that solve; only blocks with 4 k <= m (basis width m) fuse, wider blocks such as the first append of every solve keep the separate products; bit-identical on the aarch64 pure kernel, rounding class on MKL and x86)

BAANDI_LEAN_PROJ_CACHE.meaning: C3a: the lean real Gamma Davidson keeps P^T V (projector products) beside its basis (copied after each H apply, rotated at contraction and return) and the audit's nonlocal energy reads P^T X = (P^T V) C instead of a fresh n x n_proj x bands product; falls back to the direct product whenever the cache is incomplete; rounding class

BAANDI_M2_ATOMIC.meaning: atomic start on the M2 path: replicated, or split (span columns, two-pass Gram-Schmidt first passes, H Q and the Gram columns split over ranks with one broadcast per column and one allgatherv; Gram-Schmidt bit-identical, Gram block GEMM rounding class)

BAANDI_M2_ATOMIC_BLOCK.meaning: INIT-SCALE: with M2_ATOMIC=split, every rank fills its contiguous block of span rows (same elementwise arithmetic) and the span is orthonormalized by a row-distributed CholQR2 (local Gram GEMM, one tree_sum, replicated Cholesky and triangular inverse, local update; twice; one allgatherv of the rows) instead of the column-cyclic two-pass Gram-Schmidt whose second pass is a serial chain over the columns; falls back to the split Gram-Schmidt when a pivot is below the dependence guard or data is nonfinite; rounding class (span and trajectory change)

BAANDI_M2_B5.meaning: distributed Davidson bordered (secular) reduced eigen update when one column was appended (the serial B5; rounding class)

BAANDI_M2_BATCH.meaning: batched FFT transposes of the M2 path

BAANDI_M2_CAPACITY.meaning: MPI runs with four or more ranks use 3 Davidson basis columns per band when scf.davidson_capacity_per_band is not set (auto), else the default 6 (off)

BAANDI_M2_DENSITY.meaning: M2 distributed density on the standard path: bands (per-band plane contributions kept, then summed) or fused (plane density accumulated in ascending band order, no bands x plane buffer; the per-band data only serves the strict certificate screen); bit-identical

BAANDI_M2_DGEMM.meaning: distributed Davidson rotations and projections and the M2 nonlocal products through the per-panel dgemm at any width (MKL builds: rounding class; pure builds bit-identical)

BAANDI_M2_EIGEN.meaning: distributed Davidson reduced eigenproblem: replicated (every rank solves) or root (rank 0 solves and broadcasts the lowest pairs; bit-identical)

BAANDI_M2_FFT.meaning: 1D kernels of the M2 distributed FFT (mkl: MKL DFTI batch lanes on MKL builds, rounding class; pure builds stay rustfft)

BAANDI_M2_GRID.fallback_reason: not the M2 path (one rank or row-block path)
BAANDI_M2_GRID.meaning: M2-GRID: on the M2 path (2+ ranks, LDA PZ/PW, no core density, density floor or symmetry) the full-grid stages outside the solve run on a slab-decomposed full-grid FFT (owned real-space planes, owned sticks, two transposes per transform): the input density's Hartree FFT pair, the LDA XC and the effective potential on the planes with one allgatherv of the effective potential and the partial sums; the energy audit's output-density Hartree FFT and grid sums on the planes with one allgatherv of partial sums; the stop-rule Coulomb estimate from the kept owned coefficients; every sum in a canonical plane/stick order, so results do not depend on the rank count; rounding class against the replicated path

BAANDI_M2_LAYOUT_CACHE.meaning: BREAKTHROUGH-4: the distributed solver reuses the row-index layout (row counts and global row lists of every rank) of its previous solve on the same thread when every rank's local rows are unchanged (one 1-double reduction decides, replicated), instead of two allgathervs (one of N doubles) and the index rebuild per solve; bit-identical

BAANDI_M2_LAZY.meaning: MPI-LAZY-ORBITALS: a standard (Ritz-change) M2 solve inside the SCF session returns only this rank's stick rows of the eigenvectors (no N x B allgatherv, no complex unpack); the next solve starts from those rows, the density, nonlocal and kinetic energy are formed from them (kinetic: one reduction of B values), and the full complex block is gathered once, on first demand (result, checkpoint, ladder hand-off, spectral audit, explicit nonlocal audit), and cached; gathered blocks are bit-identical, the energy is rounding class (distributed kinetic sum)

BAANDI_M2_LAZY_RESULT.meaning: LAZY-RESULT: when the caller declared that it reads no delivered orbitals (dft-cli run without forces, stress, ELF or partial-charge output, classic mode), an M2 result keeps its lazy distributed orbital blocks instead of gathering the full N x B block on every rank at delivery; ScfResult::materialize_orbitals gathers them on demand (collective); energy, density, eigenvalues and history unchanged; off = always gather

BAANDI_M2_LAZY_SERIAL.meaning: ISSUE-20: an M2 real Gamma solve state owns only the ORC half-sphere descriptor and the distributed operator; the serial real Gamma Hamiltonian (pair plans, real projector table) is built lazily only when a fallback applies it (distributed operator unavailable, threads path); supersedes M2_LIGHT_STATE on the M2 path when on; bit-identical

BAANDI_M2_LEAN.meaning: distributed Davidson residuals and corrections by slice loops without per-element index checks; bit-identical

BAANDI_M2_LEAN_ALGEBRA.meaning: MPI-OVERLAP-DAVIDSON: standard (Ritz-change) distributed Davidson solves run the serial lean algebra: unit-norm corrections appended without Gram-Schmidt, the overlap S = V^T V kept beside H_r with its inverse Cholesky factor (pivot rule eps/1e-12, reprojection and Ritz-basis fallbacks), reduced problem T H_r T^T; the S border, the H border and the selected residual norms share one tree sum per iteration; strict solves unchanged; implies the workspace path; rounding class

BAANDI_M2_LIGHT_STATE.meaning: BREAKTHROUGH-4: on the M2 path the replicated serial real Gamma Hamiltonian of a solve state (rebuilt at every new problem and ladder stage) is built with the minimal block capacity 2 instead of the Davidson capacity: one pair FFT plan and scratch instead of capacity / 2 full-grid plans per rank; it only supplies the ORC half sphere there and is never applied (the full operator is built if the distributed operator is unavailable); bit-identical

BAANDI_M2_LOCAL_DENSITY.meaning: M2-OWNED (default on since 2026-11-18, dev08 si32/si64 np=8 wall -2.5 to -6.0 %; declines automatically for active-boundary consumers): with M2_LOCAL_FIELDS and M2_MIX on, the output density stays on the owned slab planes through the energy audit, the stop rule, the session metrics (residual, charge, minimum: canonical per-plane sums), the distributed Pulay mixer (window on the owned planes) and the next potential; the full density is gathered only for a consumer that needs it (delivered result, checkpoint, ladder hand-off, declined map); rounding class against M2_MIX alone (per-plane instead of per-chunk canonical sums)

BAANDI_M2_LOCAL_FIELDS.meaning: M2-OWNED (default on since 2026-11-18, dev08 si32/si64 np=8 wall -2.5 to -6.0 %; declines automatically for active-boundary consumers): with M2_GRID on the M2 standard path, the effective potential stays on the producing ranks' slab planes (the planes the distributed H apply multiplies; redistributed by one alltoall only when the slab and operator plane axes differ) and is fed to the distributed operator and its kept-start potential change (delta V) without the full-grid allgatherv; the complex Hamiltonian's full potential is gathered only for a consumer that needs it (cold atomic start, complex or M1 fallback), tagged with an epoch so a stale potential is rejected; bit-identical to M2_GRID alone

BAANDI_M2_MIX.fallback_reason: not the M2 path (one rank or row-block path)
BAANDI_M2_MIX.meaning: M2-GRID: on the M2 path (2+ ranks) plain Pulay mixing (no Hartree metric, no Kerker) keeps its window of input densities, residuals and differences on the rank's block of fixed 4096-point chunks only: the newest difference, its Gram row and the right-hand side on the block with one allgatherv of per-chunk partial sums added in chunk order (rank-count independent), the replicated small eigenproblem, the update and the two charge corrections on the block, one allgatherv of the new density; exact checkpoints reject the mixer (opaque state); rounding class against the replicated mixer

BAANDI_M2_ORTHO.meaning: distributed Davidson orthonormalization: classic (three basis projections, two whole-block sweeps) or serial (the serial solver's order: one projection, DGKS second pass, panel Gram-Schmidt; rounding class)

BAANDI_M2_OWNED_HANDOFF.meaning: G-HANDOFF-OWNED: experimental direct coarse-to-fine owned ORC transfer by Miller index; unchanged full-matrix fallback for unsupported consumers, default off pending dev08 measurement

BAANDI_M2_PANEL_GS.meaning: distributed panel Gram-Schmidt reductions per column: classic (two dot reductions and one norm), pythag (norm rides with the second dots, Pythagorean update, 2 reductions), fused (input norm rides with the first dots, second pass only when the per-column DGKS rule of BAANDI_ORTHO fails, about 1 reduction); rounding class

BAANDI_M2_REUSE.meaning: MPI-KEPT-START: a standard (Ritz-change) M2 stick-row solve that starts from the previous solve's orbitals X takes X and H X from that solve's local rows (the return rotation of the H images) plus (V_new - V_old) X, formed from the plane slabs the M2 density build kept (one forward transform per occupied pair, no inverse transform, nonlocal product or kinetic pass), when initial equals X to 1e-14 and the Gram defect of X is at most 1e-12; the local rows of X come from the solver (no extraction from the gathered block); falls back to the plain start otherwise; rounding class

BAANDI_M2_SCREEN.meaning: certificate screen clusters on the M2 path: replicated (every rank transforms the cluster bands on the full grid) or dist (band values on each rank's FFT planes, local sums plus one tree_sum per cluster; rounding class of the screen estimate only)

BAANDI_M2_SELECTED_ROOTS.meaning: distributed Davidson Ritz-change (standard) solves: unconverged roots decided from the Ritz-value change first, Ritz vectors, H images and residuals of those roots only, all bands rotated only at return and restarts (the serial lean rule); strict solves unchanged; implies the workspace path; rounding class

BAANDI_M2_START.meaning: start of a distributed Davidson solve (workspace path): ortho (panel Gram-Schmidt of the start block) or gram (one Gram matrix and one reduction; a start block with Gram defect at most 1e-12, the restart contraction rule, is taken as the basis without Gram-Schmidt, otherwise ortho; rounding class)

BAANDI_M2_STICKS.meaning: stick partition of the M2 distributed FFT: greedy (sticks one by one to the least loaded rank) or mirror (a stick and its Gamma mirror stick go to the same rank as one unit, so no ORC representative is split and the two mirror alltoalls of every apply vanish; rounding class: rows are summed in a different order)

BAANDI_M2_WORKSPACE.meaning: distributed Davidson keeps its basis, products, reduced matrix (fixed leading dimension, border update), Ritz, residual and orthonormalization buffers, GEMM and EVD workspaces in a per-rank workspace reused across iterations and solves (no per-iteration large allocation); bit-identical to off

BAANDI_MGS.meaning: Gram-Schmidt variant (default blocked on MKL builds, classic otherwise)

BAANDI_MIX_COULOMB_GUARD.meaning: SCF-TRAJECTORY: plain Pulay (L2 fit) measures the residual its least squares predicts, R - dR gamma, in the Coulomb (Hartree-energy) metric; on: when that predicted residual is larger than the current one in the Coulomb metric, this step's coefficients are refitted in the Coulomb metric (no tuned constant: the rule is 'the fit must not predict a larger long-wavelength error'); trace: compute and record the ratio, never act; replicated PulayMixer and the M2 distributed mixer (chunk and owned-plane modes, Coulomb forms on the owned sticks; MIX-COULOMB-GUARD-DIST); not kerker-pulay, not mixing_metric = hartree

BAANDI_MIX_GROWTH_RESET.meaning: reset the mixing history when the residual grows by more than this factor

BAANDI_MIX_INCREMENTAL.meaning: Pulay mixer keeps its difference vectors (and their metric images) and the Gram matrix entries across calls and forms only the newest difference and Gram row per step (O(m N) instead of O(m^2 N) grid work, no per-step difference allocation; ticket MPI-REMAINING); bit-identical

BAANDI_MKL_DGEMM.meaning: rotation panels by MKL dgemm (MKL builds)

BAANDI_MKL_EVD.meaning: reduced symmetric eigensolve by MKL (MKL builds)

BAANDI_MKL_NONLOCAL.meaning: nonlocal products by dgemm on the real Gamma path

BAANDI_MPI_M2.meaning: MPI stick-row (M2) path; off selects the M1 row-block path

BAANDI_MPI_TREE.meaning: message pattern of the deterministic MPI tree sum: binomial (reduce to rank 0 plus broadcast, 2 log2 P rounds), rd (recursive doubling with MPI_Sendrecv, log2 P rounds) or rhd (REL-TREE-RHD: payloads of at least 2048 doubles by a recursive-halving reduce-scatter plus a recursive-doubling allgather, 2 (P-1)/P of the payload moved instead of log2 P times it; smaller payloads rd); all bit-identical for power-of-two rank counts, other counts stay binomial; read by the CLI at MPI start

BAANDI_NL_ENERGY.meaning: nonlocal energy from blocked projections (exact: band-by-band operator)

BAANDI_NL_ENERGY_REAL.meaning: audit nonlocal energies from one real projector product on the real Gamma path

BAANDI_NONLOCAL_BLOCK.meaning: complex (k-point) nonlocal of a band block by two GEMMs (P48C; auto: when n_pw x n_projectors x 16 B >= 256 KiB)

BAANDI_ORTHO.meaning: DGKS second-pass rule of the Davidson orthogonalization (value = ratio, null = two passes)

BAANDI_ORTHO_BLOCK.meaning: panel Gram-Schmidt of the correction block, L2 shape-rule panel width (P48D; overrides MGS; default on in pure builds where it replaces the serial classic sweep, off on MKL builds where MGS-B already blocks)

BAANDI_PACK_FIXED.meaning: PERCORE-KERNELS: the aarch64 pure GEMM kernel packs full eight-row strips and stores full tile columns by constant-length copies instead of one memmove call per eight doubles (bit-identical; acts on pure builds on aarch64 only)

BAANDI_PAIR_FFT.meaning: pair FFT plan of MKL builds (pruned: stick lanes)

BAANDI_PHASE_PROFILE.meaning: exclusive nested phase profile per rank (init / coarse SCF / fine ordinary SCF / verification pass and fail / materialization; map phases and solve stages inside; maximum over ranks and imbalance); clocks follow BAANDI_STAGE_TIMERS (off: counts only); printed by dft-cli (results.json phase_profile, parallel.phases), m2_entry_cost and davidson_bench

BAANDI_PHASE_THREADS.meaning: P48F: thread the atomic start (span build, two-pass Gram-Schmidt right-looking) on the SCF pool; bit-identical

BAANDI_PHASE_VALIDATE.meaning: G-PHASE-VALIDATE: owned projector finite-dot validation uses a sufficient numerical range proof (finite momentum and position components with maxima <= 2^500); otherwise retains the original pair loop and errors; coefficients and lazy materialization unchanged; off until dev08 A/B

BAANDI_PHASE_WAIT.meaning: wait probe of the phase profile (ticket BREAKTHROUGH-4-OTHER-AND-INIT): a timed barrier before every collective of the distributed solver and at the entry of every M2 solve, so that the time ranks spend waiting for the last rank (load imbalance, arrival skew) is reported apart from the collective's own transfer (`solve.wait`, `solve.entry_wait`, `coll.barrier`); changes the timing (extra barriers), never the arithmetic; diagnostic only, never an acceptance arm

BAANDI_POTENTIAL_REUSE.meaning: certificate solve reuses the screen's Hartree/XC fields

BAANDI_PROJECT_WIDE.meaning: basis-projection apply X -= Q S and MGS-B cross-panel apply through the per-panel dgemm at any block width (MKL builds; pure builds unchanged)

BAANDI_PURE_GEMM.meaning: pure-Rust real GEMM panels: nano tiles or one packed product per panel (P48B; default packed in pure builds, nano on MKL builds where dgemm replaces these sites)

BAANDI_REFERENCE_STRICT.meaning: ADR 0043 (2026-11-16): force the strict reference SCF path with its fixed-point certificate (accuracy gates and tests); off = the single standard path with verification

BAANDI_RELAX_EXTRAPOLATION.meaning: overrides the relaxation density extrapolation of the input file

BAANDI_RESTART_KEEP.meaning: BREAKTHROUGH-1-RESTART R1-b: at a contraction restart of the lean Davidson (serial lean path and the distributed lean algebra) keep, besides the Ritz vectors X and H X, up to r previous Ritz vectors of the unconverged roots with their X component removed (P = Y - X A, H P = (H V)(D - C A): no new H application); r is a count or a fraction of the band count (b/4 = bands / 4, at least 1), limited by the room left for the next correction block; directions whose squared sine to span(X and the kept directions) falls below the pivot rule eps/1e-12 are dropped, and the restart falls back to X alone when the factor of the new basis fails the pivot rule; off = the plain restart (bit-identical)

BAANDI_REUSE_PSI.meaning: C2: a lean real Gamma Davidson solve that starts from the previous solve's orbitals X takes H X from that solve's rotated H images plus (V_new - V_old) X, formed from the psi(r) the density build kept (one forward transform per pair; no inverse transform, nonlocal product or kinetic pass); falls back to the plain apply when X, the operator or the grid changed or the cache exceeds its memory gate; rounding class

BAANDI_RITZ_FUSED.meaning: fused Ritz rotation (loop: only the selected-root residuals inside the lean Davidson iteration, where H X is not kept; the return keeps the pair rotation that REUSE-PSI needs; PERCORE-KERNELS)

BAANDI_ROTATE_KERNEL.meaning: rotation kernel of the tiled workspace

BAANDI_SCF_ADVANCE.meaning: BREAKTHROUGH-3 (docs/design/bounded-subspace-scf.md): intermediate standard-path maps of the serial real Gamma lean path run a bounded subspace update (`Advance`: at most SCF_ADVANCE_BLOCKS correction blocks from the kept start) instead of a solve to the ratchet tolerance; the map is completed by the exact solve at the same density when its residual estimate exceeds 0.1 x the Coulomb SCF residual, when the SCF residual is below the threshold (convergence candidate) or grew, or when the occupied/empty Ritz values cross; the stop rule, the verification and the delivered state use exact maps only; trajectory change, standard class unchanged

BAANDI_SCF_ADVANCE_ADAPT.meaning: SCF_ADVANCE research: adapt the block budget from the previous advanced map's inner/SCF ratio (off: the budget stays at SCF_ADVANCE_BLOCKS)

BAANDI_SCF_ADVANCE_BLOCKS.meaning: starting number of correction blocks per advanced map (SCF_ADVANCE=on); the session adapts it by one block from the inner/SCF residual ratio of the previous advanced map

BAANDI_SCF_ADVANCE_GROWTH.meaning: SCF_ADVANCE research: complete an advanced map whose Coulomb SCF residual grew against the previous map (off: growth is left to the mixer, as on the exact path)

BAANDI_SCF_ADVANCE_SCOPE.meaning: SCF_ADVANCE research: advanced maps in every standard session (all) or only outside the cutoff-ladder coarse stage (fine)

BAANDI_SNAPSHOT_DIR.meaning: SCF snapshot capture: every real Gamma solve of the run writes the state that replays it (input density, this rank's orbital rows, kept H X and its armed flag, tolerance, policy, layout hash, context) to this directory outside the timed map phases; replay with davidson_bench --snapshot <manifest.json>

BAANDI_SPIN_SHARE.meaning: share exactly degenerate fixed-sector standard spin solves (bit-identical effective potentials and occupations; default on since 2026-11-17: dev08 si8 -18.1 %, si16 -23.8 %; mpi, strict and unequal-sector fallbacks verified clean)

BAANDI_STAGE_TIMERS.meaning: F21: MPI stage and collective counters measure wall time (on, the earlier behaviour) or run count-only (off: calls and collective payload bytes counted, no clock read, stage seconds 0)

BAANDI_STANDARD_RESIDUAL_GUARD.meaning: standard-class stop also requires sum_k w_k sum_occupied f_i |r_i|^2 x 1 Ha^-1 (empirical second-order band-energy estimator, not a bound; review F03) below the threshold

BAANDI_STANDARD_STOP.meaning: standard-class stop rule: plain threshold, or confirm (also stop when the estimator is within 2x the threshold, the previous step within 20x, and it contracted by 0.3 or better)

BAANDI_STOP_METRIC.meaning: standard stop-rule Coulomb estimate E_H[rho_out - rho_in]: fft (transform the residual forward and back on the full grid) or kept (Parseval sum over the map's own Fourier coefficients of rho_in, kept from the Hartree potential, and rho_out, kept from the energy audit; no FFT; falls back to fft when a density was clamped or the kept coefficients do not belong to the two densities; rounding class of the estimate only)

BAANDI_STOP_PREDICTOR.meaning: SCF-TAIL: second estimate of the ADR 0043 fixed-point verification from the two maps it already has, -X = -E_H-form <rho_out - rho_in, F(rho_out) - rho_out> (one extra Coulomb-metric evaluation, no extra solve); in the linear Hartree model -X / (true energy error of the delivered state) = 1 + A >= 1, while the old criterion E_H[F(rho_out) - rho_out] reads A (1 + A) (A = Coulomb-weighted static response); measured on the Mac set -X / T >= 0.654, so it is not a bound; trace: print both and the verification energy change, never act; on: an attempt whose old criterion fails also passes when 0 < -X < threshold / 4 (safety factor from the held-out calibration), the stop estimate is below the threshold and the residual guard passes; replicated densities only (the owned-plane loop keeps the old criterion)

BAANDI_VERIFY_REUSE.allowed: off, warm, feed, feed2, replace, half
BAANDI_VERIFY_REUSE.meaning: reuse of a failed fixed-point verification solve (F at the delivered density rho_out): warm = the next SCF step starts from its orbitals (so the REUSE_PSI kept start is taken); feed = warm and the pair (rho_out, F(rho_out)) also enters the mixer after the step's own pair, so the next input density is mixed from it (the verification map counts as an SCF map); off = discarded; rounding class (trajectory changes, acceptance still needs a passed verification)

BAANDI_VERIFY_SCHEDULE.meaning: F-VERIFY-SCHEDULE: geometric retry prediction from existing Coulomb errors; off preserves the original path, trace records predictions, on defers predicted failures with a bounded retry horizon; certificate and stop threshold unchanged

BAANDI_WIDE_DOT.meaning: wide dot products in the orthogonalization

threading.backend: persistent Rayon pool shared by k points and fixed inner pieces; sequential faer and serial FFT per worker

certificate.note: wall of the certificate blocks (screen, re-solve, checks); phases_s is already inside timings.phases

closure.note: total = setup + phases + certificate_outside_phases + step_overhead + ladder_coarse + remainder; atomic_start_s is inside phases (potential of the first map)

timings.fft_hpsi: included in enclosing phases; not separately measured

units: Ha, Ry, eV, Bohr, seconds and bytes as keyed; density_residual in Bohr^-3/2; electrons/occupations in electron counts; relative errors and fractions dimensionless; see docs/cli.md

verification.criterion: E_H[F(rho_out) - rho_out] < threshold_ha (and the residual estimate residual_bound_ha, an empirical estimator, not a bound, when BAANDI_STANDARD_RESIDUAL_GUARD=on); strict_criteria_met is information only
verification.note: delivered state is the converged step's own; a failed attempt continues SCF; work is also in the history entry's fixed_point_certificate

launch.note: Local monotonic seconds from main entry; no cross-rank clock subtraction. init.cli already includes input/preflight/UPF; engine_construction and materialize are also inside covered_s. Detail timers are nested, not additive. preflight includes Config::prepare, its UPF parse and per-k basis checks; prepare_reuse only takes that prepared value. Binary SHA is inside run_block. Each rank retains its existing output files; read rank*/results.json for other ranks. main_wall_s ends before this small launch append; external wall minus main_wall_s includes pre-main launcher/loader, final append and post-main runtime/OS teardown. No fsync or new barrier. MPI finalize time includes waiting for slower ranks.
